integrity: The proof independently checks stable integer shifts of the Gaussian derivative and generalizes the source's Wronskian multiplicity mechanism from common first-derivative zeros to common m-th derivative zeros. The new combinatorial row-order count gives multiplicity N-m exactly; the source's translate independence, automorphy, and sharp Gaussian zero-density argument then imply the arithmetic restriction. No numerical computation is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: For derivative order m>=2 the theorem is one-sided: rational products with denominator deficit q-p<=m are not classified. The result is for rectangular lattices and fixed Gaussian-derivative windows, not arbitrary polynomial-times-Gaussian windows or the standard higher Hermite functions.
title: Arithmetic safety for Gaussian-derivative Gabor frames
